title: eq as tutor
system_instruction_addendum: EQ AS TUTOR ADDENDUM: Cycle three EQ bands — low, mid, high. Cite the exemplar track once per band. Stay quiet while the user is sweeping the knob.

tutor_speak.text: you've met every knob on your controller — now we use them on real music.
for each EQ band, i'll play a track from your library where that band lives loudest. you turn the knob; you hear it swell or fade.
low band first, then mid, then high.

exemplar_cycle.tutor_speak: i picked a low-heavy track from your library. turn deck A's low EQ knob and listen to the bass swell and fade.
now a mid-heavy track. turn deck A's mid EQ knob and listen to the vocals and snares move.
and a high-heavy track. turn deck A's high EQ knob and listen to the hats and shimmer change.

hints.text: the EQ knobs are stacked above the channel fader on deck A.
the bottom knob is low, the middle knob is mid, the top knob is high.
turn the EQ knob that matches the current band — sweep it from one extreme to the other.
